message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to current air‑quality data, so I can’t tell you the exact AQI for Los Angeles at this moment.  

If you’d like up‑to‑date information, you can check one of the following:

| Source | What it offers | How to use |
|--------|----------------|------------|
| **AirNow** (U.S. EPA) | Current AQI, forecast, and pollutant breakdowns for all U.S. cities | Visit https://www.airnow.gov/, enter “Los Angeles” or your ZIP code. |
| **EPA’s Air Quality Index app** | Mobile app for iOS/Android that shows real‑time AQI and health recommendations | Download from the App Store or Google Play. |
| **Local news sites** (e.g., LA Times, KABC) | Often publish daily air‑quality summaries | Search “Los Angeles air quality” on their websites. |
| **Weather apps** (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather) | Many include AQI in their weather reports | Look for the “Air Quality” section in the app. |

If you’re looking for historical trends or a deeper analysis of Los Angeles’ air quality, let me know and I can help explain typical patterns, major pollutants, and health impacts.
